'''Iron Cesta Flight''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] and was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] exclusively by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. The squadron patrolled the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] preying upon the traffic between [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] colony.

It was established by Gungans, including [[Toba]], who volunteered for service with the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps in of the wake of [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

The members of this group flew [[G-1 starfighter]]s, which were built as a joint venture between [[BullbaBong]] and [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]]. G-1s superficially resembled the royal [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] but were equipped for longer periods of independent operation and sustained combat in-system.
